documents.content:
PROJECT BRIEF: hi

MISSION
To redesign the core user interface to significantly enhance user engagement and ensure full accessibility compliance.

SCOPE
The project encompasses two primary phases:
1. Discovery: Conducting user research (interviews and usability testing) and performing a comprehensive audit of existing UI/UX bottlenecks.
2. Execution: Developing high-fidelity prototypes in Figma and implementing responsive frontend components using React.

GOALS
- Increase user retention by 15%.
- Achieve full WCAG 2.1 accessibility compliance.
- Reduce page load time by 30%.
- Finalize all design assets by June 30, 2024.
- Ensure 100% unit test coverage for all new components.

CONSTRAINTS & RISKS
- Timeline: The project must be completed within the window of June 1, 2024, to September 30, 2024.
- Scope Management: To prevent delivery delays, the project will strictly adhere to the approved feature list and follow a formal change request process to mitigate scope creep.
- Technical Quality: To prevent technical debt and maintain system stability, the team must integrate regular code reviews and automated testing into the development workflow.

EXECUTION PLAN: UI REDESIGN PROJECT

PROJECT OVERVIEW
Objective: Redesign the core user interface to increase user retention by 15%, achieve WCAG 2.1 accessibility compliance, and reduce page load time by 30%.

PHASE 1: DISCOVERY
Timeline: June 01, 2024 – June 30, 2024
Focus: Research and requirement gathering.

Workstreams:
- User Research (Owner: UX Lead): Conduct user interviews and usability testing to identify friction points.
- Audit (Owner: UX Auditor): Analyze existing UI/UX bottlenecks and accessibility gaps.

Key Milestone:
- Finalization of all design assets and requirements by June 30, 2024.

PHASE 2: EXECUTION
Timeline: July 01, 2024 – September 30, 2024
Focus: Design implementation and development.

Workstreams:
- UI Design (Owner: UI Designer): Create high-fidelity prototypes in Figma based on Discovery findings.
- Frontend Development (Owner: Lead Frontend Engineer): Build responsive components using React.

Key Milestone:
- Achievement of 100% unit test coverage for all new components by September 30, 2024.

SEQUENCING AND DEPENDENCIES
1. Completion of the Audit and User Research is a prerequisite for finalizing design assets.
2. High-fidelity Figma prototypes must be approved before Frontend Development begins.
3. Implementation of React components must follow the established UI Design specifications to ensure accessibility compliance.

OPERATIONAL AUTOMATIONS
- Issue Management: New Jira issues will trigger automated alerts in Slack (#dev-alerts).
- Progress Tracking: GitHub Pull Request merges will automatically update project status in Notion.

RISK MITIGATION
- Scope Creep: Managed via strict adherence to the approved feature list and a formal change request process.
- Technical Debt: Mitigated through mandatory regular code reviews and integrated automated testing.

RISK LOG: Project hi

RISKS AND MITIGATIONS

1. Scope Creep | Delayed project delivery | Strict adherence to the approved feature list and implementation of a formal change request process.
2. Technical Debt | Reduced code quality and system instability | Integration of regular code reviews and automated testing within the development workflow.
3. Inaccurate User Requirements | Design fails to meet user needs or accessibility standards | Completion of comprehensive User Research and Audit phases prior to the Execution phase.
4. Performance Regression | Failure to achieve 30% reduction in page load time | Implementation of performance monitoring and load testing during Frontend Development.
5. Accessibility Non-Compliance | Failure to meet WCAG 2.1 objectives | Regular accessibility audits conducted throughout the UI Design and development stages.

DEPENDENCIES

1. Research Output: The completion of User Research and Audit workstreams is required to inform the UI Design prototypes.
2. Design Finalization: All high-fidelity Figma assets must be finalized by June 30 to allow Frontend Development to proceed as scheduled.
3. Testing Infrastructure: The achievement of 100% unit test coverage is dependent on the successful setup of automated testing integration during the Execution phase.

POTENTIAL BLOCKERS

1. Discovery Delays: Any delay in the Research Phase (ending June 30) will directly postpone the start of the Development Phase.
2. Asset Availability: Lack of approved design assets from the UI Design workstream will halt Frontend Development progress.
3. Compliance Failure: Inability to meet WCAG 2.1 standards during development may prevent project sign-off and deployment.

STAKEHOLDER SUMMARY: UI REDESIGN PROJECT

PROJECT OVERVIEW
A strategic redesign of the core user interface aimed at increasing user retention by 15%, achieving WCAG 2.1 accessibility compliance, and reducing page load times by 30%.

KEY STAKEHOLDERS
- UX Research Team: Responsible for user interviews and usability testing during the Discovery phase.
- UI Design Team: Responsible for creating high-fidelity prototypes in Figma.
- Frontend Engineering: Responsible for building responsive React components.
- QA/Engineering Leads: Responsible for maintaining code quality, unit test coverage (100% target), and managing technical debt.
- Project Sponsors: Responsible for approving scope and monitoring retention/performance KPIs.

CRITICAL DECISIONS REQUIRED
- Requirement Sign-off: Formal approval of research findings and audit results by June 30 to transition from Discovery to Execution.
- Design Approval: Final validation of Figma prototypes before the development phase begins in July.
- Scope Control: Immediate decision-making required for any feature requests outside the initial plan to prevent project delays caused by scope creep.

COMMUNICATION & MONITORING
- Real-time Alerts: Technical issues and new Jira tickets will be automatically broadcast to the #dev-alerts Slack channel.
- Project Status Tracking: The Notion project dashboard will update automatically upon GitHub Pull Request merges to ensure real-time visibility into development progress.
- Milestone Reviews: Scheduled updates at the end of June (Design Completion) and September (Development Completion).

ACTION REGISTER: UI REDESIGN PROJECT

ID | TASK | PRIORITY | ASSIGNEE | NEXT ACTION
01 | Conduct User Research & Usability Testing | High | UX Researcher | Draft interview scripts and recruit participants.
02 | Perform UI/UX Bottleneck Audit | High | UX Auditor | Document existing friction points in the current interface.
03 | Create High-Fidelity Figma Prototypes | Medium | UI Designer | Finalize all design assets by end of June deadline.
04 | Develop Responsive React Components | Medium | Frontend Developer | Establish component architecture and folder structure.
05 | Implement WCAG 2.1 Accessibility Standards | High | Frontend Developer | Integrate ARIA labels and keyboard navigation support.
06 | Configure Automated Unit Testing Pipeline | Medium | Frontend Developer | Set up testing framework to ensure 100% coverage goal.
07 | Establish Scope Control Workflow | High | Project Manager | Define change request process to mitigate scope creep.

SPRINT CHECKLIST: PROJECT HI (DISCOVERY PHASE)

EXECUTION STEPS
- Conduct scheduled user interviews and usability testing sessions.
- Complete comprehensive UI/UX bottleneck audit on the existing interface.
- Document all identified accessibility gaps relative to WCAG 2.1 standards.
- Identify specific technical requirements needed to achieve the 30% page load time reduction goal.

HANDOFFS
- Deliver finalized research insights and user personas to the UI Design workstream.
- Transfer the completed Audit Report to the Frontend Development team for technical feasibility review.
- Ensure all design assets are finalized and ready for implementation by June 30.
- Verify that all new audit issues are correctly triggering Slack notifications in #dev-alerts via Jira.

REVIEW POINTS
- Review research findings to ensure they align with the 15% user retention goal.
- Conduct a mid-sprint scope review to prevent expansion of the feature list (Scope Creep mitigation).
- Validate that all identified technical bottlenecks are documented for the upcoming Development Phase.
- Confirm all new components identified in the audit are prepared for 100% unit test coverage requirements.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS: PROJECT HI

OVERVIEW
Redesign of the core user interface to optimize engagement, accessibility, and performance.

CORE TECHNOLOGY STACK
- Frontend Framework: React (Component-based architecture)
- Design Tooling: Figma (High-fidelity prototyping and design handoff)
- Version Control: GitHub (Branch management and Pull Request workflows)
- Project Management: Notion (Status tracking and documentation)
- Issue Tracking: Jira (Task management and bug reporting)

TECHNICAL OBJECTIVES & IMPLEMENTATION
- Performance Optimization: Implement code splitting, asset compression, and lazy loading to achieve a 30% reduction in page load time.
- Accessibility Compliance: Integrate WCAG 2.1 standards into the component library, focusing on semantic HTML, ARIA attributes, and keyboard navigation.
- Testing Requirements: Achieve 100% unit test coverage for all new React components using automated testing frameworks.
- Quality Assurance: Mandatory integration of automated testing in the CI/CD pipeline and regular peer code reviews to mitigate technical debt.

AUTOMATION & INTEGRATION PIPELINE
- Alerting System: Jira-to-Slack integration; any new issue creation triggers an immediate notification to the #dev-alerts Slack channel.
- Project Synchronization: GitHub-to-Notion integration; successful Pull Request merges trigger automated status updates within the Notion project database.

DEVELOPMENT WORKFLOW
1. Discovery Phase: UI/UX audit and user research data collection.
2. Design Handoff: Finalized Figma assets transferred to development.
3. Execution: React component development following strict adherence to the approved feature list to prevent scope creep.
4. Deployment: Automated testing validation followed by production merge.

RELEASE READINESS REPORT: Project hi

OVERVIEW
Project Goal: Redesign core UI to increase user retention by 15%, achieve WCAG 2.1 compliance, and reduce page load time by 30%.

COMPLETION CRITERIA
- Design Finalization: All high-fidelity Figma prototypes approved and transitioned to development.
- Feature Completion: All React components developed according to the approved feature list (Scope Control).
- Documentation: All project statuses updated in Notion and technical documentation finalized.
- Asset Delivery: 100% of design assets prepared for production deployment.

QUALITY ASSURANCE CHECKS
- Accessibility Audit: Verification of all new UI elements against WCAG 2.1 compliance standards.
- Performance Validation: Benchmarking tests to confirm a minimum 30% reduction in page load time.
- Code Integrity: Achievement of 100% unit test coverage for all newly developed components.
- Technical Debt Review: Completion of mandatory code reviews and successful integration of automated testing suites.
- Usability Verification: Final validation against user research findings to ensure engagement goals are met.

LAUNCH READINESS CHECKLIST
[ ] All design assets finalized (Deadline: End of June).
[ ] Unit test coverage reaches 100% for all new components.
[ ] Automated PR sync and issue notification systems (Jira/Slack) verified as operational.
[ ] Regression testing completed to ensure no impact on existing core functionality.
[ ] Performance benchmarks met in a staging environment.
[ ] Final scope audit completed to prevent unauthorized feature inclusion.

STATUS: PRE-EXECUTION (Awaiting completion of Discovery Phase)
